answer:
Headline results of run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (PoroTomo DAS, Brady Hot Springs, March 2016):

- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20; 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, covering 3.314% of the time window).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 detections above the catalogue magnitude of completeness Mc).
- Pumping context: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction, not injection).
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED — catalogue-based (Shapiro et al. 2021, Eq. 5), using the LBNL/NCEDC catalogue (this is the calibrated probability):
  b = 1.0 : Sigma = -5.449, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198, P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 5.236e-06, P(Mw>=3)/yr = 0.03719
  b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922, P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0002155, P(Mw>=3)/yr = 0.2809
  b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474, P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0006484, P(Mw>=3)/yr = 0.4653

UPPER BOUND — DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection is counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts (this is NOT calibrated):
  b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

Bottom line: the calibrated (LBNL catalogue) annual probability of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 earthquake ranges from ~1.2e-4/yr (b=1.0) to ~1.5e-2/yr (b=0.65); the DAS-based 0.078/yr is only an upper bound with uncalibrated magnitudes and over-counts.
